name: Podrig's Order
summary: At the Sepulcher, Podrig's Order calls for fresh weapons from the Undercity.

sections.title: Arming the Sepulcher
sections.body: Deathguard Podrig found the Sepulcher's stores mostly adequate after an inventory ordered by Executor Hadrec. Replacement weapons were running desperately low. His dispatch lists the blades and arms needed by the Deathguards holding the outpost in Silverpine Forest, a frontier threatened by the Scourge, feral beasts, and other dangers.

sections.title: Dispatch via Bat Handler
sections.body: The order goes to Gordon Wendham, a weapon dealer in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, because the damp crypts of Silverpine make forging weapons difficult. Couriers carry the document to bat master Karos Razok, using Forsaken flight paths to speed the shipment from the capital.

faq.q: What is written in Podrig's Order?
faq.answer: Podrig's Order lists replacement weapons for the Deathguards at the Sepulcher, whose arms have been lost or broken in the field.
Deathguard Podrig wrote the order at Executor Hadrec's direction, after an inventory of the Sepulcher's armory.
Gordon Wendham, a weapon dealer in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, is meant to receive the order.

faq.q: Why does the Sepulcher need new weapons?
faq.answer: The Deathguards need new weapons because skirmishes with the Scourge and other hostile forces in Silverpine often leave their equipment broken or lost.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see how the Undercity supplies outposts like the Sepulcher, keeping the Dark Lady's soldiers armed against the Scourge.
As a blacksmith, you know how vital forged weapons are on the front lines, where combat continually drains a garrison's supplies.
